items.prompt: This bridge module's main job is to…
choices: connect learn_digital FSM/datapath/memory concepts to Verilog coding practice
introduce a brand-new browser lab id
items.explain: Module 18 is a bridge: reuse concept labs as prompts, then write matching .v sketches.

items.prompt: In RTL, the FSM (control) usually lives in…
choices: a clocked always block with state and case
items.explain: State registers and transitions are sequential; they belong in clocked always logic.

items.prompt: The datapath in a processor sketch is mostly…
choices: combinational logic (mux, ALU, etc.) between registers
items.explain: Datapath computes from current operands; registers capture results on the clock edge.

items.prompt: A Moore machine output depends only on the current state, not the current input.
items.explain: Moore outputs are a function of state; Mealy outputs can also depend on inputs.
